description: Change a doc's text and nothing else in it. One passage: old_text and new_text. Add to the end: append_text. The whole body: content and updated_at from your read_doc, refused when anyone edited it since, so you never overwrite the team. The text it replaces stays in the doc's version history. Presentations and storyboards change only through a task.

append_text.description: Markdown to add at the end of the doc.

content.description: The new whole doc body as Markdown.

doc_id.description: A doc id from get_task or list_space.

new_text.description: What replaces old_text. Empty deletes it.

old_text.description: The passage, copied exactly from read_doc. It must appear once: add nearby words if it repeats.

updated_at.description: updated_at from your read_doc. Needed with content; otherwise it refuses a doc edited since.

name: update_doc
title: Update doc
